name: Animated Worley Noise Texture Generation
definition: Generates a 2D Worley (Voronoi) noise texture to break up smoke silhouettes, updated per frame via compute shader.
summary: Animated Worley Noise Texture Generation creates a 2D Voronoi texture updated per frame via time-based UV offsets to break up smoke silhouettes, differing from static noise by its motion and from 3D volumes by its 2D plane operation.
